notes: v2.9.30: accumulation detection is now volume/price-behavior based instead of a fixed 3x-volume long-wick rule. A large bearish dump can be accumulation when volume is abnormal, a long upper wick can qualify with clearly elevated relative volume, and unusually large volume with only a muted price response is treated as suspicious accumulation/absorption. Relative volume uses the prior 20-bar average together with the recent 60-bar volume distribution, so visibly unusual volume can qualify below 3x. Tiny ambiguous cross/doji candles remain excluded. Individual suspicious bars are shown subtly as accumulation candidates; repeated candidates within the cluster window remain highlighted as confirmed accumulation. Bowl-3, EMA, and live-order rules remain unchanged.
